title: A browser.click chat tool for Misato
goal: Misato can ask to click a named control on the allowed page through the CDP driver; each click is an Orange action behind an approval card
acceptance: A browser.click tool reaches the F-089-T04 live driver from chat; each click is Orange behind an approval card
The CLI's allowlist, refusals and tainted page text apply unchanged; a page or control outside the allowlist is refused without a click
A test across the join: chat request → tool → approval card → fake CDP driver click (no real browser launched in tests)
Security review on #733: the click is bound to the tab and origin proposed (card shows them, grant binds them); another tab, a closed tab or another origin is refused without a click
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A change of gate class, data leaving the base, or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 from the decision's 2–3 h. Implemented 2026-11-24 in about 4 h agent with the review fixes (stated, not measured).
